crossRefs.note: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

parallels.note: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
